messages:
Priya (docs): Quick sync  Staging runbook images (several) are 403. Short-term fix idea: add `custodian:` frontmatter and rehost affected images to the canonical docs bucket. Who can pick a couple?
Ethan (infra): I can take autoscale and pg-recovery. Happy to rehost and add `custodian: Ethan (infra)`.
Ria (storage): Ill take any storage-related runbooks, e.g., kv-cache-ops. Will upload to s3://docs-assets and share path in the PR.
InfraBot: scan run 2024-11-05: 9 staging 403s, 1 prod 403. Report: https://internal/reports/asset-scan/6166
Priya (docs): Minimal PR checklist I want in every change: `custodian: NAME`, rehost S3 path, smoke test (`curl -I <url>` -> 200), CI docs/build pass.
Ethan (infra): will open PRs for autoscale and pg-recovery. Will use sed to inject frontmatter when missing.
Ria (storage): added kv-cache-ops PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2035  includes `custodian: Ria (storage)` and S3 path.
CI Bot: docs/build check queued for PR 2035.
Priya (docs): Medium-term: Lena (platform) suggested a migration to rewrite staging CDN URLs to https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs-assets/* and a nightly InfraBot scan posting summary to #docs. Can we get an infra ticket?
Ethan (infra): filing PLAT-330 for migration + nightly scan hook. Will link in PR descriptions.
Priya (docs): Great  thanks everyone. If you spot more 403s drop them here and Ill batch into the migration list. :thumbsup:
